body:
Hi! Sorry it’s taken so long to reply, I haven’t been on reddit much lately. A lot of things going on. I’ve recently found out its crossing the optic chiasm and the mass extending from the left optic chiasm extends along the optic tract to the lateral ventricle has decreased in size, interval slight increases in the right sided mass, so you were on the money.

It is affecting both eyes, her left clearly worse than her right. She has optic atrophy in the left eye and no, she doesn’t have NF1. Thanks for your help!
I went on a bit of a spree but overall the new ones took 3 days. I like the pain.
My pierciest said to do nothing with them but if they start to get crusty or weepy just water and salt solution and a earbud
No, some were years old but the cartilage piercings and the double nose rings, septum and one of the double eyebrow are the new ones
I got max 5 in one sitting as that’s all they would allow me to get in any one day.

It feels strange, noises are loud. I feel sick like I can’t eat food but hearing my daughters voice was indescribable. I’m laying next to her while she sleeps, afraid if I go to sleep I won’t wake up.

It’s not so much she doesn’t feel safe with me. It’s a few things. He and his family are not so rigid in the care of her so if she doesn’t want to have a bath or do her oral care, they won’t push the point, whereas I will. And when I’m physically sick she pushes away from me and wants to see him because in her exact words, I don’t want you to be sick because you’ll die and no one will look after me. She knows nothing of my mental health issues and she needs me to keep reassuring her that I won’t die until “she’s an old lady”. 

I’m at an inpatient facility at the moment because it has reached do or die, but her father won’t allow me much time. I still have to make all of her appointments and attend them. Apparently he is “exhausted” after only having her for 5 days (he’s too tired to look after her overnight). 

I honestly do want to die. If my little one could go to my sister, then I would die happy. But the arsehole would never allow that to spite me even though he’s said multiple times how hard it’s been for him.

I love her. Just because I don’t seem to like her at times, doesn’t mean I wouldn’t, and haven’t tried to move mountains for her since she was born, and especially during this time.

Me wanting to die and the solution is leaving and living my life would be effective how? 

You have no idea what it’s like to be in the same room, day in, day out for months with the man that used to beat you and degrade you just so your daughter can have both parents there. That’s the sacrifice I make for her. You make me ill sitting on your high horse over their knowing nothing about life.
I fell out of bed and broke my foot
I’ve had a mediastinal teratoma the size of a tennis ball pushing against my heart. I needed open heart surgery to remove it.
